text:
mikaela: Heads up — landing page surge from the webinar signup (utm=redwood_apr_launch). HS webhooks slowed and enrichment timed out. ~40 leads in a 5m window; ~10 show as intake:unclaimed. Need a quick, scoped fallback so SDRs still hit SLAs.

devon: Grafana shows webhook latency spike at 14:03 and enrichment 504s. Could be DB pool exhaustion or lambda cold starts. Any preference for targeted vs global fallback?

andre: Targeted only — match on utm and enrichment_pending to avoid wide blast radius. Plan: accept a minimal payload, create the Lead with owner = "SDR Webinar Queue" and set intake_flag suppress_task=true so SDRs get a digest instead of tons of tasks. Also add internal hs_fallback=true property.

olivia: Fine with that. I'll watch SF duplicates. Rollback criteria: dup_rate > 2/min OR suppressed_tasks > 25 in 15m. If we hit either, rollback immediately.

sam: Tech note: external_id dedupe prevents lead duplication, but owner changes will still create tasks. suppress_task flag will help. We should also add an internal note so SDRs know enrichment is pending.

mikaela: OK action items: 1) devon -> deploy intake rule for utm match + allow_partial + suppress_task (staging -> smoke -> prod). 2) devon/andre -> add hs_fallback property on affected contacts. 3) olivia -> monitor SF dup/task metrics and heartbeat in #inbound-handoff. 4) kyle -> prepare SDR digest copy and saved filter. 5) mikaela -> create JIRA for postmortem.

devon: I'll canary to staging first. Curl to patch intake config (staging):
```bash
curl -X PATCH "https://internal-config.redwood/api/v1/lead-routing" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"round_robin": {"targeted_fallbacks": [{"match": {"utm_campaign": "redwood_apr_launch", "enrichment_status": "pending", "pending_seconds_gt": 5}, "owner": "SDR Webinar Queue", "intake_flags": {"allow_partial": true, "suppress_task": true}, "hs_fallback": "true"}]}}'
```

alerts-bot: HubSpot webhook latency 78s avg for 14:02-14:06. Enrichment 504 spike at 14:04:12.

devon: Canary applied to staging, running 30-event smoke sim. ETA ~2m.

jira-bot: Created JIRA-4022: "Webinar signup surge — intake fallback & enrichment robustness" assigned to mikaela.

andre: Added HubSpot internal note template: "Partial intake: enrichment in progress. Full profile to follow. hs_fallback=true". Pushed note to workflow id WF-778.

kyle: SDR digest ready: short subject "Webinar leads (partial profiles)" with link to saved filter hs_fallback=true and outreach copy. Set digest cadence to 10m for the first hour.

devon: Rolling to prod now after staging smoke passed. Patch applied at 14:10:11.

alerts-bot: Config patch: lead-routing updated by devon at 14:10:11.

mikaela: Olivia — monitor first 30m, call rollback if dup_rate > 2/min or suppressed_tasks > 25. Also watch for unexpected owner-changes > 3/min.

olivia: On it. Heartbeat in #inbound-handoff. If anything noisy, I'll flip rollback and notify.

sam: FYI I've also bumped enrichment DB pool max connections by +15 as a safety move; monitoring connections.

alerts-bot: DB pool increase applied by sam at 14:12:03. Enrichment 5xx trending down.

devon: First 10m: suppressed tasks = 9, dup_rate = 0. No anomalies.

mikaela: Great. Keep fallback for 1 hour then revert unless we decide to extend. Postmortem owners: mikaela, devon, sam. Thanks team. :tada:
